candidate_generation: src/candidates_v2.py: 16 arcs with the smallest exact point-to-segment distance (<=40 m sub-segment index, 96 shortlisted)

feature_notes.bearing_delta: |wrap(gps_bearing - arc_bearing)| in radians (pi/2 when direction unknown); one-step displacement
feature_notes.bearing_delta_smooth: same, from a +-2-fix window (>=3 m displacement, no gap > 5 s)
feature_notes.cos_bearing / cos_bearing_smooth: cosine of the above, 0 when direction unknown
feature_notes.speed_aligned / speed_aligned_smooth: speed * cosine of the bearing difference
feature_notes.obs_dist_rank / rel_dist: rank of the candidate by distance (1..16) and distance minus the closest candidate's

score: decision_function(pipeline, X)   (logit of the class-weighted model)
